meta.title: ISO 27001 Scope Statement - Windows Enterprise Lab

sections.title: 1. Introduction and Purpose
sections.body: The Information Security Management System (ISMS) is established to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets supporting the agent-based risk analysis and assessment project for Windows-based environments.

sections.title: 2. Organizational Boundaries
sections.body: The ISMS applies to the technical infrastructure and management processes overseen by the Project Manager for the development and testing of the risk assessment prototype.

sections.title: 3. Geographic and Physical Boundaries
sections.body: The scope includes the controlled lab environment used for development and validation testing:
bullets: Development Lab: Primary environment hosting the physical hardware for the Windows Server and Workstation instances.
Remote Access: Secure local management of the development environment.

sections.title: 4. Technical and Logical Boundaries
sections.body: This ISMS encompasses the Windows-based enterprise ecosystem specifically defined in the technical architecture:
bullets: Identity & Infrastructure Server: One Windows Server instance acting as the Domain Controller (DC), hosting Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), DNS, and DHCP roles.
Enterprise Endpoint: One Windows 11 Desktop workstation, domain-joined and managed via Group Policy Objects (GPO).
Agent Deployment: Locally hosted agent-based monitoring software operating on both the Server and Workstation.
Logical Network: Isolated virtual or physical network segment providing connectivity between the DC and the Windows 11 endpoint.

sections.title: 5. Exclusions and Justifications
sections.body: The following areas are excluded from the scope of the ISMS:
bullets: External Network Services: Justified because the lab operates in a controlled, isolated environment to ensure data privacy.
Hardware Maintenance: Justified because physical hardware integrity is managed at the facility level, outside the direct control of the project scope.

sections.title: 6. Stakeholders and External Dependencies
sections.body: The scope also accounts for the security requirements of:
bullets: Academic Infrastructure: Systems used to store and submit project deliverables.
Technology Vendors: Microsoft, for OS-level security updates and technical documentation.
